blocks.text: Nowruz, a Persian name meaning **new day**, is the new year of spring. It is celebrated from Iran to Central Asia at the spring equinox, when day and night are the same length. In Turkmenistan it begins on 21 March and, by tradition, lasts three days. Its Turkmen names include *Nowruz baýramy* and *Bahar baýramy*, the spring festival, and 21 and 22 March are public holidays.

Nowruz is shared by many peoples, and UNESCO lists it as one tradition with many names. It was first inscribed in 2009 for seven countries; in 2016 a new file of twelve countries, Turkmenistan among them, replaced that listing. In 2010 the United Nations General Assembly also proclaimed 21 March the International Day of Nowruz.

The dish of the season is *sümelek*, a sweet brown paste made from sprouted wheat and flour. Its juice is pressed from wheat that has been left to sprout for days, then cooked and stirred for many hours in a large cauldron, traditionally through the night, often by women singing together. In the morning, the warm sümelek is handed out to neighbours, relatives and friends. Fresh green wheat shoots, a sign of the new season, also decorate the celebrations.

Another sign of Nowruz in Turkmenistan is the swing, *hiňňildik*. Tall wooden swings, often wound with flowers, go up in towns and in the open country, and a ride on one is said to cleanse you for the new year. Around them there are yurts, music, the *küştdepdi* dance you met in [A1 unit 9](a1-u09-culture), games, and visits between families.

blocks.title: Nowruz in numbers
blocks.text: With this unit you can say it all: *Nowruz 21-nji martda* (Nowruz is on 21 March), *üç gün* (three days), *ýazyň birinji güni* (the first day of spring).
With the words of this unit, you can read this:

blocks.tk: Şu gün 21-nji mart, Nowruz. Bu ýazyň birinji güni. Biz atamyň öýüne barýarys. Irden sagat sekizde sümelek taýýar!
blocks.en: Today is 21 March, Nowruz. It is the first day of spring. We are going to my grandfather's house. At eight in the morning the sümelek is ready!
